title: Activity Page Action Permission Alignment

items.action: show and execute single/bulk activity deletion and row selection
load customer filter options and expose customer navigation from activity rows/details

migration.reason: The consumed permission codes already exist in Core.

backend.reason: Existing activity delete and customer read backend authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No API contract changes are introduced.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend resource lookup, query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: Existing backend hard-delete audit behavior is unchanged.

menu.reason: Main Activities navigation remains controlled by activities.read; this delivery controls actions and related-customer affordances.

route_guard.reason: The existing `/activities` read route guard is unchanged.

notes: Activities remain readable through the existing activities.read route guard. Selection, single delete, bulk delete and destructive confirmation UI require activities.delete. Customer filter loading and customer-navigation affordances require customers.read. If effective permissions change while destructive UI is open, selection and confirmation state are cleared. Backend authorization remains authoritative.
